narrative.overview: A dark instrument panel where data is visibly moving. Near-black blue surfaces seamed with hairline slate borders; two indicator lamps divide all meaning — Signal Violet for what is in motion (records in flight, the current milestone, the in-dev surface) and Proof Teal for what has arrived (links, shipped capabilities, measured numbers, the live cursor). Diagrams are animated instruments: SMIL particles ride SVG paths through the log spine, the reactor orbit, and the fabric mesh. The one sanctioned blend of the lamps is the violet→teal gradient — hero phrase, benchmark bar fills, featured wash: motion arriving at proof. The honesty machinery (status pills, evidence blocks, the milestone rail, ledger-cited numbers) is first-class brand material.
keyCharacteristics: Two accents with disjoint jobs: violet = in motion / current, teal = proven / interactive; their gradient blend is reserved for three sites
Hairline slate seams and one tonal step carry all depth; the terminal keeps the single drop shadow
Archivo 800 headlines; JetBrains Mono speaks the chrome — nav, buttons, kickers, stat values — uppercase and tracked
Diagrams are animated instruments: particle flows, a pulsing tail block, doorbell rings, scroll-triggered bar growth
Measured, not promised: only ledger-Allowed numbers render, inside evidence blocks and stat tiles with disclosures

rules.name: The Two Lamps Rule
rules.body: Violet marks what is in motion (current, in-dev, in-flight); teal marks what is proven or actionable (shipped, measured, clickable). If swapping an element's lamp would not change its meaning, the color is decoration and therefore wrong. The gradient is their only blend and appears in exactly three places: the hero headline phrase, benchmark bar fills, and the featured-card wash.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule (extended)
rules.body: Prose is always Archivo. Everything small, structural, machine-generated, or actionable-chrome — labels, tags, paths, code, statuses, nav links, buttons, stat values — is JetBrains Mono, uppercase and tracked. No third font.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: The terminal keeps the site's only drop shadow. Every other surface separates with a seam and the panel step; card hover lifts via transform + violet border, never a shadow.

rules.name: Measured, Not Promised
rules.body: Numbers on the site come only from Allowed/Narrowed claim-ledger rows, rendered in evidence blocks or stat tiles with box/cells/tier disclosed. Targets never appear (master plan §18); what is absent is named, with the reason.

dos: Do keep every measured number inside an Evidence Block or stat tile citing an Allowed ledger row — the ledger-copy CI check fails the build otherwise (L10).
Do pin a status pill or milestone tag to every capability mention, including terminal commands and diagram nodes.
Do give each lamp its own job and keep the gradient to its three sanctioned sites.
Do state what is absent and why — designed absence is brand material.
Do ship the reduced-motion fallback for every animation, including SMIL particles (.anim-dot hides) and observer-triggered bars (full-width by default).
donts: Don't publish targets as numbers anywhere on the site — targets live in the master plan, measurements on the page.
Don't blend or swap the lamps: no teal NOW dots, no violet links, no gradient outside its three sites.
Don't add drop shadows to new surfaces (One Shadow Rule).
Don't write 'REPLACES X' as a claim — capability taglines say TARGETS …; comparisons exist only as in-run measured rows.
Don't hand-edit site/docs/compat.html — it is generated and CI fails on drift.
Don't spread the numbered-kicker system beyond the landing page.
